scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate dark-theme palette with CSS custom properties, muted accent blue, and uppercase panel labels show real design intent, but the network graph renders as an illegible hairball and the overall layout is too information-dense for the panel sizes allocated.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: All circular encodings use scaleSqrt, bar chart has a zero baseline with data-driven domain, and color/hue axes use semantically correct fixed ranges — structurally honest throughout with no dual-axis or radius-deception issues.
scores.stress_test_note: Solid RAF+dirty-flag coalescing prevents rendering storms, no feedback loops or stale scales, no transitions to conflict mid-flight, but synchronous O(n) bitset recomputation on every brush event is an unthrottled CPU cost.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter views stay manageable — the network pre-computes its layout and labels only the top 20 nodes, but the color scatter and thumbnail wall simultaneously display high-density unlabeled elements that shift from comparison to browsing.
flags: Update Storm (partial): bitFilter.set() + bitFilter.filtered() run synchronously on every brush mousemove event (O(n) over 34k blocks), though DOM mutations are correctly deferred via RAF dirty-flag
Mouse-Touch Fight (minor): D3 brush instances have no explicit .filter() guard to prevent scroll vs. brush conflict on touch devices
